page: OVHcloud h200-1920 is a specialized cloud GPU instance designed for large-scale accelerated computing tasks. The system is provisioned on KVM virtualization using an x86_64 architecture and provides 224 dedicated virtual CPUs clocked at 3.0 GHz. Accompanying the compute cores is 1920.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 8.57 GB per vCPU. Acceleration is delivered via eight integrated NVIDIA Hopper H200 GPUs providing a combined total of 1128 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM (141 GB per GPU). For local disk input and output, the instance bundles 31120 GB of high-capacity NVMe SSD storage, paired with a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

The architectural emphasis of this platform centers on massive parallel throughput and extensive memory capacity. With eight Hopper H200 accelerators and over a terabyte of collective VRAM, memory-bound model training and inference benefit from high throughput without frequent host-to-device data offloading. The local 31.1 TB NVMe array delivers substantial capacity and low-latency storage for caching datasets and model checkpoints directly on the host. However, the system includes 0 complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and its baseline network throughput of 25 Gbps may require external network orchestration for multi-node clustering across instances.

Given its 8-way GPU layout, abundant VRAM, high-density host memory, and large NVMe storage volume, the OVHcloud h200-1920 is tailored for training foundation large language models, high-throughput distributed AI inference pipelines, complex scientific simulations, and large-scale deep learning workflows requiring high data locality.
description: OVHcloud h200-1920 is a high-density GPU server built for intensive accelerated computing and large-scale model workloads. Virtualized via KVM on an x86_64 architecture, the platform features 224 dedicated vCPUs operating at 3.0 GHz and 1920.0 GB of host RAM, delivering 8.57 GB of memory per core. The instance integrates eight NVIDIA Hopper H200 GPUs offering a collective 1128 GB of GPU memory, alongside 31120 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a 25 Gbps baseline network link. This configuration pairs extensive accelerator capacity with fast local storage, minimizing external I/O bottlenecks during checkpointing and dataset ingestion. While the 25 Gbps network interface and lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses demand structured network planning, the server delivers high resource consolidation. OVHcloud h200-1920 is suited for large language model pre-training, fine-tuning, high-concurrency generative AI inference, and complex scientific computing.
